mapper.insert: INSERT INTO treatment (category_id, treatment_name, description, is_reservable, is_visible, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{categoryId}, #{treatmentName}, #{description}, #{isReservable}, #{isVisible}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT treatment_id, category_id, treatment_name, description, is_reservable, is_visible, created_at, updated_at FROM treatment ORDER BY treatment_id
SELECT treatment_id, category_id, treatment_name, description, is_reservable, is_visible, created_at, updated_at FROM treatment WHERE category_id = #{categoryId} ORDER BY treatment_id
mapper.update: UPDATE treatment SET treatment_name = #{treatmentName}, category_id = #{categoryId}, description = #{description}, is_reservable = #{isReservable}, is_visible = #{isVisible}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE treatment_id = #{treatmentId}
